properties.notes: BH2019/03548 Approved Aug 2020. PPA Signed April 2017. Pre App discussions. The previous use of the proposed development site as a railway yard and industrial site presents a high risk of contamination that could be mobilised during construction to pollute controlled waters. The east and south sides of the site has some history of contaminative use and this is referenced in the RSK land contamination report of 4/8/17.
